svg.title: Where does Agent Code observe a native provider?
svg.desc: Agent Code owns the PTY and launch environment, then observes the provider from outside: rendered terminal output, the model stream, durable history on disk and the process itself. Each point answers a different question.
svg.text: Where does Agent Code observe a native provider?
Claude Code and Codex CLI sessions · OpenCode replaces the proxy and JSONL points with its own server and database

svg.text: Blue: Agent Code · Gray / dashed border: external · Amber: checks and cautions
Arrow: read its label in the arrow direction. Cylinder: stored data. Diamond: a check.
